name: bluechip Trading
description: [bluechip] Trades, intents, approvals and batches, by environment.

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.trades.filled`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.trades.value`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.trades.failed`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.intents.blocked`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.trades.filled`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `source` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.trades.value`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `source` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.trades.value`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `side` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.trades.size`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.5, 0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.intents.ended`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.intents.blocked`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `policy` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.intents.waited`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `reason` using sum

charts.name: Intent duration p50 / p95 by executor (s)

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.intents.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `executor` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.5, 0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.approvals.requested`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `reason` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.approvals.resolved`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.approvals.time_to_resolve`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `outcome` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.5)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.batches.created`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `legs` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.batches.waves_sent`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.trades.fees`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `kind` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.trades.slippage`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.gas.sponsored`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `kind` using sum
